title: Patch: a friend's 2v2 lobby keeps offering Join on their row while any of its three guest seats is empty, not only until the first guest enters
thread:
**Issue #4108 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4108: Patch: a friend's 2v2 lobby keeps offering Join on their row while any of its three guest seats is empty, not only until the first guest enters
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

A 2v2 lobby has four seats: the host and three guests. As soon as the first guest sits down, the host's other online friends stop seeing "In a lobby" and a Join button on the host's row in their friends list. They see plain "Online" and Challenge instead, though two seats are still free.

They can still get in, but only if the host sends each of them an invite or the code. That happens at the very moment the host most needs friends to find the lobby. Once this is built, the host's row keeps offering Join until all four seats are taken. A 1v1 or co-op lobby already works that way: its row offers Join until its one guest seat is taken.

## Why

- `GET /api/friends` reads every online friend's open lobbies in one query, `lobbies_open_of_hosts` (`crates/server/src/social/friends.rs:156`).
- Both stores keep only lobbies whose first guest seat is empty:
  - Postgres, at `crates/server/src/lobby/store.rs:375`: `where host = any($1::uuid[]) and guest is null and started_at is null`.
  - The in-memory store, at line 509: `&& lobby.guest.is_none()`.
- A 2v2 lobby fills `guest` first: `empty_place` (`crates/server/src/lobby/mod.rs:193`) takes the first empty seat in order. So the host's row loses its code at the first entry.
- SPEC §9.4 (`spec/09-architecture.md`, presence) says a friend's row carries "the code of an online friend's lobby with an empty seat".
  - R3732001 and the README's `GET /api/friends` row say "whose guest seat is empty", wording written when every lobby had one guest seat.
  - The 2v2 patch (R3731000) added `guest2` and `guest3` and extended `of_member` (`lobby/store.rs:350`), but not `open_of_hosts`.
- No test covers a 2v2 lobby here. `tests/api/friends.rs`'s `r3732001_an_online_friend_with_an_open_lobby_carries_its_code_and_a_full_or_started_one_none` and the store contract's case both use 1v1 lobbies only.
- The client only draws what the server sends (`apps/web/src/together/friendGroups.ts` reads `lobbyCode`; CLAUDE.md rule 7), so the fix is the server's alone.

## Proposal

- Postgres (`open_of_hosts` in `lobby/store.rs`): keep an unstarted, unexpired lobby of a listed host when `guest is null or (settings->>'format' = '2v2' and (guest2 is null or guest3 is null))`. `count_open_by_host` already reads `settings->>'format'`.
- In-memory store: apply the same rule, and watch for one trap. `Lobby::others` always has two entries, which are empty in every format but 2v2. A plain "any of `others` is empty" would therefore list every full 1v1 and co-op lobby. Read the seats by format instead, as `places` and `empty_place` do.
- §9.4 already makes the decision, so no new ruling is needed.
  - Correct R3732001's "whose guest seat is empty" to "with an empty seat".
  - Correct the doc comment on `Tx::lobbies_open_of_hosts` and the README row the same way.
  - Name the new tests `r3732001_…`, in files R3732001's `proven_in` already lists.
- Nothing else changes. An entry is still the server's to refuse (a block, a full seat), and the list stays one read for all friends.

## Where it lands

- `crates/server/src/lobby/store.rs`: both `open_of_hosts` and the `Tx` doc comment
- `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs`, `crates/server/tests/api/friends.rs`
- `crates/server/README.md` (`GET /api/friends` row), `spec/rulings/R3732001.md`; SPEC §9.4, R3731000

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Store contract, on both stores, for a host's lobbies:
  - a 2v2 lobby with `guest` taken and `guest2` or `guest3` empty is listed;
  - one with all three taken is not listed;
  - a started one is not listed;
  - a 1v1 lobby and a co-op lobby with `guest` taken are not listed (the `others` trap).
- [ ] `tests/api/friends.rs`: Bea, online, hosts a 2v2 lobby, and Cyd enters. Ada's `GET /api/friends` gives Bea's row its `lobbyCode`. Once two more people have entered, the row has none.
- [ ] The existing R3732001 tests pass unchanged.
- [ ] These pass: `cargo test -p jackioh-server`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo jackioh spec check`. CI's `db` job runs the new contract case against Postgres.

## Size and risks

Small: two predicates, two tests and a few lines of docs. Risks:
- The Postgres predicate must name the format's stored word, `2v2` (`FORMAT_TWO_V_TWO`).
- The contract case runs against real Postgres only in CI's `db` job, since `sh crates/server/tests/db/run.sh` needs Docker. A mistake in the SQL would show up there, not in `cargo test`.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44154836394)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Fix `lobbies_open_of_hosts` so a 2v2 lobby stays listed (and its host's friends row keeps its Join/`lobbyCode`) until all three guest seats are taken, not just until `guest` fills. A 1v1 or co-op lobby with `guest` taken, a started lobby, and a full 2v2 lobby stay unlisted. No new ruling: §9.4 already says "with an empty seat"; only wording written for one-guest lobbies is corrected.

## Files to touch

| Path | New / change | What changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/server/src/lobby/store.rs` | change | `pg::open_of_hosts` predicate; `fake::open_of_hosts` predicate; `Tx::lobbies_open_of_hosts` doc comment ("empty guest seat" → "empty seat") |
| `crates/server/src/social/friends.rs` | change | `Friend::lobby_code` doc comment ("whose guest seat is empty" → "with an empty seat") |
| `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs` | change | New `r3732001_…` case in `mod lobbies` + register it in that module's `both_stores!` list |
| `crates/server/tests/api/friends.rs` | change | New `r3732001_…` test in `mod r3732001_a_friends_row_says_more` |
| `crates/server/README.md` | change | `GET /api/friends` row: "whose guest seat is empty" → "with an empty seat" |
| `spec/rulings/R3732001.md` | change | `lobbyCode` bullet: "whose guest seat is empty" → "with an empty seat" (one line; `proven_in` already lists both test files, no change there) |

Do not touch: `apps/web/**` (client only draws `lobbyCode`, rule 7), `crates/engine`, `crates/ai`, `crates/server/migrations/**`, `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/pending/**` (no new ruling, so no new file), `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`.

Governing spec: §9.4 presence paragraph ("the code of an online friend's lobby with an empty seat"), R3732001, R3731000 (2v2 seats; `FORMAT_TWO_V_TWO = "2v2"` in `store.rs:50`).

## Steps

1. `crates/server/src/lobby/store.rs`, `pg::open_of_hosts` (~L371): replace `where host = any($1::uuid[]) and guest is null and started_at is null` with `where host = any($1::uuid[]) and started_at is null and (guest is null or (settings->>'format' = $3::text and (guest2 is null or guest3 is null)))`, moving the `expires_at` bind to `$2` and binding `FORMAT_TWO_V_TWO` as `$3`. Keep the `order by created_at desc, code` and the `is_uuid` early-outs unchanged. Pattern to copy: `count_open_by_host` (~L328) already reads `settings->>'format'`.
2. Same file, `fake::open_of_hosts` (~L503): replace `lobby.guest.is_none()` with a format-gated check: list the lobby when `guest` is `None`, or when `lobby.settings.format() == FORMAT_TWO_V_TWO` and `lobby.others` holds an empty seat (`member.profile.is_none()`). Do not use a bare "any of `others` is empty": `others` is `[LobbyMember; 2]` and empty in every non-2v2 format (struct def ~L83), so that would list full 1v1/co-op lobbies. `fake` currently imports only `super::Lobby`; add `FORMAT_TWO_V_TWO` (or match `LobbySettings::TwoVTwo`, copying `two_v_two` in `lobby/mod.rs:107`). Keep the sort and the `hosts.contains`, `started_at`, `expires_at` clauses.
3. Same file, `Tx::lobbies_open_of_hosts` doc (~L148): change "with an empty guest seat" to "with an empty seat".
4. `crates/server/src/social/friends.rs` (~L59): change the `lobby_code` doc to "the code of an online friend's lobby (R3730000) with an empty seat and which has not started…".
5. `crates/server/README.md` friends row (~L254) and `spec/rulings/R3732001.md` `lobbyCode` bullet (~L14): same wording fix ("whose guest seat is empty" → "with an empty seat"). No `proven_in` change; no `cargo jackioh spec check` breakage expected.
6. `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs`, `mod lobbies`: add `async fn r3732001_lists_two_v_two_lobbies_with_an_empty_seat(harness: &StoreHarness)`. Build lobbies with the existing `lobby()` helper plus `spread(..., json!({"settings": {"format": "2v2"}}))` for 2v2 rows (pattern copied from `r3731000_a_two_v_two_lobby_keeps_its_other_team`, ~L9682) and seat them via `lobbies_update` with `{"guest": …, "others": […]}`. Cases, all unstarted/unexpired unless noted, queried via `lobbies_open_of_hosts`: 2v2 with `guest` taken and `guest2` (or `guest3`) empty is listed; 2v2 with all three taken is not; started 2v2 with an empty seat is not; 1v1 (`FORMAT_DUEL`) with `guest` taken is not (its `others` are empty by default — this is the trap); co-op (`FORMAT_COOP`) with `guest` taken is not. Register the name in the module's `both_stores!` list (~L9734).
7. `crates/server/tests/api/friends.rs`, `mod r3732001_a_friends_row_says_more`: add `async fn r3732001_a_two_v_two_lobby_keeps_its_code_until_every_seat_is_taken`. Pattern copied from `r3732001_an_online_friend_with_an_open_lobby_…` (~L755) and `two_v_two`/`enter` in `tests/api/lobbies.rs` (~L659, ~L707): Ada befriends Bea; Bea creates `POST /api/lobbies` with `json!({"format": "2v2"})`; heartbeat Bea so she reads online; Ada's `GET /api/friends` shows Bea's row `lobbyCode` equal to the code; Cyd enters (`POST /api/lobbies/{code}/enter`, body `Value::Null`) and the row still carries the code (heartbeat Bea again first if needed so she stays online); Dov and Eli enter and the row's `lobbyCode` is gone. Use the file's existing `account`, `befriend`, `heartbeat`, `lists`, `friend_entry` helpers.

## Tests

- `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs`: new `r3732001_lists_two_v_two_lobbies_with_an_empty_seat` (both stores; CI's `db` job runs the Postgres half). Run: `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server_store lobbies`.
- `crates/server/tests/api/friends.rs`: new `r3732001_a_two_v_two_lobby_keeps_its_code_until_every_seat_is_taken`. Run: `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::friends::r3732001`.
- Existing R3732001 tests must pass unchanged (same two commands also cover them).
- Checks: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] A 2v2 lobby with `guest` taken and `guest2` or `guest3` empty is listed; full, started 1v1/co-op-with-guest-taken are not (contract, both stores).
- [ ] Bea's row keeps `lobbyCode` after Cyd enters and loses it after two more enter (API test).
- [ ] Existing R3732001 tests pass unchanged.
- [ ] The three wording fixes are in; `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-server`, clippy, and `cargo fmt --check` pass.

## Risks

- SQL must name the stored format word `2v2` (`FORMAT_TWO_V_TWO`), not `twoVTwo`: the settings JSONB holds `{"format": "2v2"}` per the `LobbySettings` serde tag. Mitigation: copy `count_open_by_host`'s `settings->>'format'` read and bind the constant.
- The `others` trap: a format-blind "any empty `others`" check lists full 1v1/co-op lobbies, since their `others` are always empty. Mitigation: gate on the format, and the contract case pins a seated 1v1 and co-op as unlisted.
- The contract's Postgres half needs Docker (`sh crates/server/tests/db/run.sh`) and runs only in CI's `db` job; a SQL typo shows there, not in `cargo test`. Mitigation: keep the SQL edit minimal and symmetrical with the fake predicate.

## Open questions

None. No person-only step: all files are bot-editable, no secret or dashboard setting is needed.
```
